timeline.event: The Truth in Fur Labeling Act ended the US exemption that congressional reports linked to unlabeled or mislabeled raccoon dog fur.
The EU added the raccoon dog to its list of invasive alien species of Union concern under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/1262.
Experimental infection showed raccoon dogs are susceptible to SARS-CoV-2 and transmit it to in-contact animals without clinical signs.
Genetic tracing of Huanan market samples found raccoon dog DNA in SARS-CoV-2-positive samples from a wildlife stall.
EFSA identified locomotory disorders and isolation stress as species-specific welfare consequences for farmed raccoon dogs.

timeline.event: A study of six Tanzanian sisal factories found byssinosis in about 48% of brushing department workers but about 5% of spinning workers.
A life cycle assessment showed that sisal fiber greenhouse gas results depend on local practice, including wet or dry disposal of leaf residues.
A review assessed sisal fiber as reinforcement for geopolymer building materials.
Pectinase treatment was reported to produce spinnable sisal fiber of about 5.8 tex with a tenacity of about 38.5 cN/tex.

timeline.event: Selected microorganisms were tested for biosoftening coir fiber.
An environmentally friendlier method for extracting coir fiber was reported.
FAO statistics recorded about 475,000 tonnes of brown coir fiber from India and about 90,000 tonnes from Sri Lanka.
Alkali treatment tests showed that 5% NaOH barely changed coir tensile strength over 48 hours, while it weakened abaca after about 12 hours.
Drying at 90 C, mercerizing and epoxy coating raised the stiffness of Colombian coir fibers for polylactic acid composites.
